title: Proud to present my masterpiece
author: Caninetechnology
selftext:
Used up my Astra credits making GANG WIZARD. This is in a very rough state, but I wanted to show off the physics and destructible environments. Feel free to tear this demo apart in the comments, I'm going for a Postal style humor where the game kinda laughs at itself for being so bad. 

Mean the world for anyone to try it out  [https://coyne-studios.itch.io/gang-wizard](https://coyne-studios.itch.io/gang-wizard) !

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body:
the best part to me was the ending with the destructible building that you could then basically make a tornado whirlwind with. 

It seems like everything is potentially a weapon in this game including the enemies, and i feel like that's the greatest selling point of the game.

There was this old PC game I remember called die by the sword and it had these really strange janky controls to move the sword in like all directions, but you could cut off an enemies arm that was holding an axe, then pick up their arm and beat them with their own arm , so your game brought me flashbacks of that haha

  
I dunno if the game would be able to handle this, but I feel like eventually you should get so powerful that there are scenarios where you enter a battle that's almost on the scale of dynasty warriors, you're making wirlwinds of body parts throwing horses at dudes, casting lightning and fire everywhere

replies.author: Caninetechnology
replies.body:
I really like the idea of large scale battles I will test that out when my usage resets, if the graphics stay at xbox360 quality then the game should be able to handle something impressive. I can imagine exactly what you mean with like a tornado of soldiers and artillery spinning around causing chaos, thank you for the reply

  
The old PC game for me was Crysis! You could pick up dudes and throw them into shacks destroying everything, that blew my mind that a 2000's era computer could handle all of that. Im gonna search up die by the sword gameplay it sounds hilarious
